svg.text: Kubernetes components · as they run in this cluster
The K3s server on master is the control plane; both VMs run the node agents; K3s bundles the add-ons in kube-system.
The front door: kubectl, kubelets and controllers all talk to it.
Datastore · SQLite via kine (etcd in full K8s)
Stores every object: the desired and current state of the cluster.
Picks a node for each new pod from requests, affinity and taints.
Control loops: ReplicaSet, StatefulSet, HPA, nodes, endpoints.
Cloud API glue. K3s ships its own; ServiceLB provides load balancers.
Starts the pods assigned to its node, runs probes, reports status.
Programs iptables so a Service IP reaches the pods behind it.
Container runtime: pulls images from Docker Hub and runs them.
Pod network: every pod gets an IP reachable from both nodes.
From kubectl apply to a running pod
